content.description: KISMI.APP is a social Telegram Mini App built around gamified photo voting. Its TON App listing describes real-time tournaments where users join a global community, gain popularity, collect kisses, and unlock rewards. The product is driven by user profiles, voting activity, and Telegram-native engagement, so it fits the SocialFi category. For TON and Telegram users, KISMI.APP turns community activity into a wallet-connected, reward-aware, or creator-focused experience. KISMI.APP is kept in this TON set because its product has a concrete user or builder workflow, not only a loose mention of the network.
